title: Cartwise Rewards Points Reversal on Item Refunds — Ledger Note
content:
When an item refund is booked on an order that has already earned Cartwise Rewards points, the base and multiplied points earned on the refunded amount are reversed in proportion, rounded down (floored), one reversal per refund entry.

## Terms of the reversal

1. **What triggers it.** An item refund booked on an order that has already earned points.
2. **What is taken back.** The base and multiplied points earned on the refunded amount, in proportion: the share of those points that the refunded amount bears to the qualifying spend they were earned on, with any fraction of a point dropped.
3. **How many reversals.** One reversal per refund entry. A refund entry that already has its reversal on the account does not produce a second one; this is read from the company's record of reversals already booked against that refund entry.
4. **The floor at zero.** A reversal never takes the balance below zero. The part of the reversal that the balance does not cover is dropped.
5. **Bonus lines.** Bonus lines are not reversed unless the order's qualifying spend falls below the bonus minimum.

## Worked note (hypothetical inputs)

A hypothetical order earned 83 base points on $67.80 of qualifying spend. An item refund of $13.56 is then booked on it.

| Step of the figure | Result |
|---|---|
| Share of the qualifying spend refunded | $13.56 of $67.80, that is one fifth |
| Points earned on the refunded amount | 83 multiplied by one fifth, that is 16.6 |
| Rounded down | 16 points reversed |

- If the balance stood at 200 points (hypothetical), 16 points come off and the balance becomes 184.
- If the balance stood at 10 points (hypothetical), the reversal takes the balance to zero; the 6 points it does not cover are dropped.
- If a second item refund of a further $6.78 were booked on the same order (hypothetical), it is a separate refund entry and has its own reversal: 83 multiplied by one tenth, that is 8.3, rounded down to 8 points.

## Bonus lines, hypothetical

A hypothetical order earned a bonus with a $35.00 minimum on $50.00 of qualifying spend.

| Qualifying spend after the refund | Bonus line |
|---|---|
| $40.00 (still at or above $35.00) | Not reversed |
| $30.00 (below $35.00) | The exception in term 5 is reached: the order's qualifying spend has fallen below the bonus minimum |

## Basis Q&A

**Can a refund reversal leave a negative balance?** No. It stops at zero and the rest is dropped.

**Is a reversal booked twice for the same refund entry?** No. There is one reversal per refund entry.
